tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: Brand colour, exact. Large tinted fields, illustration, avatar and empty-state grounds, progress tracks, and secondary text or icons on surface-inverse. As a ground it carries text only.

tokens.name: brand-steel
tokens.usage: Brand colour, exact. The interactive blue: reach it through primary, link, info and focus-ring rather than directly.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Brand colour, exact. The ink and the dark surface: reach it through text and surface-inverse rather than directly.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, selected controls, active nav item, checked checkboxes and switches. As text or icons, on surface, surface-page, surface-sunken and primary-subtle.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of anything filled with primary.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of anything filled with primary.

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected table row, active list item, selected tab count, the heading of today's column in the schedule. Carries text, text-secondary, text-muted and primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary, primary-hover and primary-pressed fills.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links, on surface, surface-page, surface-sunken and primary-subtle. Underline on hover.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: The app canvas behind cards, tables and panels.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, dialogs, menus and input fields.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, wells, and read-only and disabled field fills.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill laid over the current ground: table rows, menu items, secondary and ghost buttons. Carries text and text-secondary on any surface; text-muted and primary only over surface and surface-page.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill laid over the current ground, for the same elements as surface-hover. Carries text and text-secondary.

tokens.name: surface-disabled
tokens.usage: Fill of disabled buttons and fields. Its text is text-disabled.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Dark surfaces: the main navigation rail and tooltips. Text on it is on-inverse or on-inverse-muted.

tokens.name: surface-inverse-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill over surface-inverse: navigation rail items. Carries on-inverse and on-inverse-muted.

tokens.name: surface-inverse-selected
tokens.usage: Fill of the current navigation rail item, over surface-inverse. Carries on-inverse.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers and table row lines, and the fill of loading skeletons. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card, panel and menu outlines on surface-page and surface.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects, checkboxes and radios at rest, on surface, surface-page and surface-sunken. On hover the edge becomes text-secondary, on focus primary.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings, body copy, table cells and field values, on surface, surface-page, surface-sunken, primary-subtle, brand-sky and every status -subtle ground.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, form labels and table column headers, on surface, surface-page, surface-sunken and primary-subtle.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Placeholders, helper text, timestamps and metadata, on surface, surface-page, surface-sunken and primary-subtle.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Labels and values of disabled controls only. Below reading contrast on purpose: never for information a person needs.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: on-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and inactive nav icons on surface-inverse, and the keyboard focus ring there.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive states: paid, completed, vaccinated, result in range. Text and icons on surface, surface-page and success-subtle, or a solid fill under on-success. Teal rather than green so it stays apart from danger for colour-blind readers.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Badge and banner ground behind success or text.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a success fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention: due soon, low stock, unconfirmed appointment, borderline result. Text and icons on surface, surface-page and warning-subtle, or a solid fill under on-warning.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Badge and banner ground behind warning or text.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a warning fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Critical and destructive: allergy alerts, overdue, out-of-range results, delete actions, field errors. Text and icons on surface, surface-page and danger-subtle, or a solid fill under on-danger.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a danger button.

tokens.name: danger-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of a danger button.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Badge and banner ground behind danger or text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a danger fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and in-progress states. Text and icons on surface, surface-page and info-subtle, or a solid fill under on-info.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Badge and banner ground behind info or text.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an info fill.

tokens.name: category-1
tokens.usage: Calendar category 1, blue: the border and marker of an appointment of the first type. A mark, not a text colour: 3:1 on category-1-subtle and on surface.

tokens.name: category-1-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill of a category 1 appointment in the schedule. Carries text and text-secondary.

tokens.name: category-2
tokens.usage: Calendar category 2, sky: the border and marker of an appointment of the second type, on category-2-subtle and on surface.

tokens.name: category-2-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill of a category 2 appointment in the schedule. Carries text and text-secondary, not text-muted.

tokens.name: category-3
tokens.usage: Calendar category 3, violet: the border and marker of an appointment of the third type. A mark, not a text colour: 3:1 on category-3-subtle and on surface.

tokens.name: category-3-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill of a category 3 appointment in the schedule. Carries text and text-secondary.

tokens.name: category-4
tokens.usage: Calendar category 4, plum: the border and marker of an appointment of the fourth type, on category-4-subtle and on surface.

tokens.name: category-4-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill of a category 4 appointment in the schedule. Carries text and text-secondary.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on light grounds: a solid 2px ring with a 2px gap in the ground colour. Holds 3:1 on surface, surface-page, surface-sunken, primary-subtle and brand-sky. On surface-inverse the ring is on-inverse-muted instead.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and drawers.

tokens.name: print-ink
tokens.usage: The only colour on a receipt: a thermal printer prints black or nothing, and greys come out as speckle. Never on screen, and not on A4 documents, which keep the text colours.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First series of a chart, and every chart with one series. The brand's steel, a step more saturated so it holds its colour beside other series. In a chart of appointment types, the type that is category-1 in the schedule.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series. The sky of the brand, deepened until it is 3:1 against surface. The appointment type that is category-2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series. The same violet as the third appointment type in the schedule.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series. The same plum as the fourth appointment type in the schedule.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth and last series: the one warm colour. Never for a warning, which has its own colour and its icon.

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: "Other", the previous period and every series that is there for comparison. The grey that steps back.

tokens.name: chart-seq-1
tokens.usage: Blue ramp, lightest step: the lowest values in a heat grid, close to nothing.

tokens.name: chart-seq-2
tokens.usage: Blue ramp, second step. The lightest step a bar or a segment may take: 2:1 against surface.

tokens.name: chart-seq-3
tokens.usage: Blue ramp, middle step.

tokens.name: chart-seq-4
tokens.usage: Blue ramp, fourth step.

tokens.name: chart-seq-5
tokens.usage: Blue ramp, darkest step: the highest values.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Dashboard figures and the one hero number on a page. Rare.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section title inside a page; dialog title.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Long-form reading: clinical notes, discharge instructions, empty-state copy.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The default. Table cells, field values, menus, paragraphs in cards.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text: totals, patient names in a row, the key value of a pair.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text, tabs, nav items.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Table column headers, badge text, group labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text, timestamps, metadata under a value.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside a badge; padding inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap in buttons, menus and the navigation rail; gap between related controls; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and button horizontal padding; table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding in dense views; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a label group and the next group.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Default card and dialog padding; page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page top padding; gap between major regions.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state and onboarding breathing room.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Largest gap: marketing and sign-in layouts only.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, badges, tags, schedule slots.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, popovers, menus.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers, large feature panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, switches.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards resting on surface-page, when a border alone is not enough.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, date pickers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and drawers, over scrim.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside badges and beside caption text.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: The default: icons in buttons, fields, menus, table rows and the navigation rail.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons beside an h1 or h2 and inside lg buttons.

tokens.name: icon-xl
tokens.usage: Icons in empty states.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of compact buttons and fields: toolbars, table rows, filters.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, fields and selects; height of a navigation rail item.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of the main action on sign-in and empty states.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Table row height in dense lists: stock, price lists, lab results.

tokens.name: row-default
tokens.usage: Default table row height.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the page header.

tokens.name: nav-rail
tokens.usage: Width of the navigation rail.

tokens.name: nav-rail-collapsed
tokens.usage: Width of the navigation rail when collapsed to icons.

tokens.name: dialog-sm
tokens.usage: Width of a confirmation dialog.

tokens.name: dialog-md
tokens.usage: Width of a form dialog.

tokens.name: dialog-lg
tokens.usage: Width of a dialog holding a table or a two-column form.

tokens.name: drawer-md
tokens.usage: Width of a side drawer that shows one record at a glance or a short form.

tokens.name: drawer-lg
tokens.usage: Width of a side drawer that holds a long form or a visit note.

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: The patient's picture in a drawer, a card or a list.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: The patient's picture at the top of the patient's page.

tokens.name: schedule-slot
tokens.usage: Height of one time slot in the schedule, and the least height of an appointment.

tokens.name: schedule-gutter
tokens.usage: Width of the time column at the left of the schedule.

tokens.name: schedule-column
tokens.usage: Least width of one column (a vet or a day) in the schedule; below it the schedule scrolls sideways.

tokens.name: content-narrow
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a single-column form or reading text.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content beside the navigation rail.

tokens.name: aside-column
tokens.usage: Width of the side column on record and visit pages.

tokens.name: paper-a4-width
tokens.usage: Width of an A4 sheet in the print preview. Invoices, vaccination certificates and discharge summaries.

tokens.name: paper-a4-height
tokens.usage: Least height of an A4 sheet in the print preview, so a short document still shows a whole page.

tokens.name: paper-a5-width
tokens.usage: Width of an A5 sheet in the print preview. Prescriptions.

tokens.name: paper-a5-height
tokens.usage: Least height of an A5 sheet in the print preview.

tokens.name: paper-receipt-width
tokens.usage: Printable width of 80 mm receipt paper. The receipt is laid out to this width on screen and on the printer.

tokens.name: paper-margin
tokens.usage: Page margin of an A4 document: the sheet's padding on screen, the page margin in print.

tokens.name: paper-margin-sm
tokens.usage: Page margin of an A5 document.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and the page header.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus, select lists, date pickers.

tokens.name: z-scrim
tokens.usage: The scrim behind a dialog or drawer.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and drawers.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips, above everything.
